steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ and use line-item awarding, matching the Rank on Line requirement.
Provide the mandatory event title required for publishing.
Choose the first available predefined RFQ template.
Add a catalogue product to the event.
Fill the pricing sheet fields for the added product.
Complete any remaining mandatory fields in the template and event form.
Commit a valid event schedule before publishing.
Invite the available mapped QA vendors as participants.
Publish the completed RFQ and capture the product's publication result.
Assert that publishing reached a real project page.
Return to the Events list to verify the published event is visible there.
Assert that the Events list rendered without an error.
Open the Live events tab where the newly published event should appear.
Assert that this plan's published event is present in the Live list.
Assert that the event row is marked Live.
